full_judgment: Article 52 of the Limitation Act giving 30 days time review. He submits that since appeal may be filed within 30 days, the review of the order should also be filed within 30 days. Mr. Yeakub Ali, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner on the other hand, submits that the application for review in the present case will be governed by Article-173 of the Limitation Act. He have heard the learned Advocates and perused the provisions of law. It appears to us that the application for review of any order in a suit will be guided by Article-73 and not by Article-52 of the Limitation Act. Mr. Yeakub Ali submits that on the 85th day from the date of the order refusing the prayer for examination of the witnesses on commission, the review application was filed. So, it was filed within time. In this view of the matter, we find no substance in the preliminary objection of Mr. N. H. Khandker.
